title: 第21章 大幕拉开第22章 沧澜王
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
“我以为你真的对什么都不感兴趣呢。”
见李元主动发问，蚩显笑道。
“如今天下，谁都无法独善其身，多了解天下形势不会是件坏事，说不定哪天我们就被卷进去了。”
“连九宫山脉也会被卷进去？”
李元一下就有了危机感。
他不希望这里受到侵扰。
“如果仅仅是诸位王侯争权夺利的战争，自然影响不到九宫山脉，最大的隐患是那些入境妖魔。”
“趁着各地混乱，妖魔肆虐吃人，日渐壮大。”
“终有一日会成为无法解决的祸患。”
蚩显述说着外界之事。
李元也意识到，事态很严重了，否则不会连深居山里的十二洞都了解如此之多。
蚩显叹道：“如今在维持中原秩序的是一个名为‘夜枭’的组织。”
“夜枭？”
李元完全没听过。
“夜枭是开辟大衍的武神，那位太祖皇帝所创，仅听历代皇帝之命，整个组织全部是实力高强的武者，历代夜枭王更是武帝级别的强者。”
“武帝又是什么级别？”
李元对武者的了解极其稀少。
“蛊师有九转，武者有九品，登临九品的武者即是武帝，再往上便是武神，与蛊仙相对应。”
蚩显解释。
“明白了。”

李元对武道早已没有幻想。
“正是夜枭组织的存在，才勉强稳住了中原秩序，让大衍在群龙无首的情况下还没快速崩塌。”
“行了，说太多也没用。”
“那些事，那些人，离我们太远，天下局势不是你我能左右，真波及到这里还要很久呢。”
“享受这段安静的时光吧。”
蚩显拍了拍李元的肩膀。
“记住我说的啊，沧澜王来了之后，一定要注意礼数，不让你卑躬屈膝，至少别怠慢了。”
……
两天后。
李元坐在残蛊楼四楼，数据面板浮现眼前。
【蛊师：李元】
【黑罐（四转0800）】
【境界：四转】
【本命蛊：气血蛊，回生蛊，三彩异火蟒】
【蛊屋：无】
【特性：分解功能已解锁，你可以将高阶蛊虫分解成低阶蛊虫，重新排列组合，往新的方向进行合成。
今日，他正式踏入了四转玄蛊师的境界。
content_en:
"I thought you really weren't interested in anything."
Seeing Li Yuan taking the initiative to ask questions, Chi Xian smiled.
"No one can be alone in this world. It wouldn't be a bad thing to know more about the world's situation. Maybe one day we will be involved."
"Even the Jiugong Mountains will be involved?"
Li Yuan immediately felt a sense of crisis.
He didn't want it to be intruded upon.
"If it is just a war between princes fighting for power, it will naturally not affect the Jiugong Mountains. The biggest hidden danger is those demons entering the country."
"Taking advantage of the chaos everywhere, demons are rampaging and eating people, growing stronger day by day."
"One day it will become an unsolvable scourge."
Chi Xian talked about the outside world.
Li Yuan also realized that the situation was serious, otherwise he would not know so much about the twelve caves deep in the mountain.
Chi Xian sighed: "Today, the person maintaining order in the Central Plains is an organization called 'Ye Xiao'."
"Nite Owl?"
Li Yuan had never heard of it at all.
"Ye Xiao is the god of war who opened up the Great Evolution. He was created by Emperor Taizu. He only obeys the orders of successive emperors. The entire organization is made up of powerful warriors. The previous kings of Night Xiao are even more powerful at the level of Martial Emperors."
"What level is Emperor Wu?"
Li Yuan knew very little about warriors.
"There are nine ranks of Gu masters, and there are nine ranks of warriors. The warriors who reach the ninth rank are the Martial Emperors, and the ones above are the Martial Gods, which correspond to the Gu Immortals."
Chi Xian explained.
"Got it."
Li Yuan has no illusions about martial arts.
"It was the existence of the Night Owl Organization that barely stabilized the order in the Central Plains and prevented Dayan from rapidly collapsing when it was leaderless."
"Okay, there's no point in talking too much."
"Those things and those people are too far away from us. You and I can't control the world's situation. It will take a long time for it to really affect us here."
"Enjoy this quiet time."
Chi Xian patted Li Yuan on the shoulder.
"Remember what I said. After King Canglan comes, he must pay attention to etiquette and not let you grovel. At least don't neglect."
…
Two days later.
Li Yuan was sitting on the fourth floor of Can Gu Building, and the data panel appeared in front of him.
[Gu Master: Li Yuan]
[Black Can (Fourth Turn 0800)]
[Realm: Fourth Transformation]
[Original Gu: Qi and Blood Gu, Resurrection Gu, Three-color Strange Fire Python]
[Gu House: None]
[Features: The decomposition function has been unlocked. You can decompose high-level Gu worms into low-level Gu worms, rearrange and combine them, and synthesize them in new directions.
Today, he officially entered the realm of a rank four mysterious Gu master.
